description: This Java class implements a service for preventing SQL injection by escaping SQL string literals and quoting identifiers based on database type (MySQL or PostgreSQL). It provides methods to encode literals safely and override identifier quoting with validation and escaping techniques.

classes.name: SqlInjectionPreventerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing SQL injection prevention by escaping literals and quoting identifiers depending on the database type.

methods.name: encodeSql
methods.description: Encodes a SQL literal for safe inclusion in queries, escaping depending on whether the database is MySQL or PostgreSQL.

methods.name: escapeMySQLLiteral
methods.description: Escapes a string literal specifically for MySQL/MariaDB using standard escape sequences.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Quotes a database identifier with proper escaping, validating allowed values if provided.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier (overloaded)
methods.description: Quotes a database identifier after validation, applying database-specific quoting.
